children: Teva priced approximately $4.9 billion (equivalent) of senior notes across five tranches and expects settlement on or about September 16, 2026.
Issued five note tranches totaling ~€1.5bn and $3.2bn across maturities 2032–2037; settlement expected Sept 16, 2026.
Euro tranches: €1.0bn 4.250% due 2033 (priced at 98.756%) and €0.5bn 4.625% due 2036 (priced at 98.327%).
Notes are unsecured senior obligations of the issuers, unconditionally guaranteed on a senior unsecured basis by Teva.
Net proceeds to fund conditional redemptions of specified outstanding notes, pay offering fees/expenses and for general corporate purposes.
